answer: Require each identity to keep one distinct public service endpoint live for the whole epoch. The network probes each endpoint at random times from verifiers spread across an ocean, with a fresh signed challenge answered within five seconds from that endpoint alone. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must rent 1,000 separate hosts, about $4,000 a month at $4 per host, and an endpoint missing three probes loses its identity and all pending rewards. Probes also record address and response timing, so a grove of endpoints sharing one mesa server counts as one identity and the rest are removed.
